text.en:
12th. DECEMBER, 2012 No. S 80

SMALL CLAIMS TRIBUNALS ORDER, 2006 IS 81/2006) Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section 1 ( 1), the Chief Justice, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the 1st day of January 2012 as the date on which the Small Claims Tribunals Order, 2006 shall commence. Made this 20th. day of Muharram, 1434 Hijriah corresponding to the 4th. day of December, 2012.

DATO SERI PADUKA A WANG HAJI KIFRAWI

BIN DATO PADUKA HAJI KIFLI Chief Justice, Brunei Darussalam.
